Wasteland Wagers (fo4roulette): credits and licences for the models it's built from

The tables' and cards' meshes and textures in Meshes\fo4roulette and Textures\fo4roulette are made from these models,
each under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), and are shared
under the same licence. Changes for the game: scaled, split into parts, given collision, textures redone or re-encoded.

Roulette table
  "Roulette Table 2" by dudzy
  https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/roulette-table-2-downloadable-b1d33eebb4f54b8aa250be2f49e87fbb
  CC Attribution (CC BY 4.0)

Poker table
  "Poker Table" by Pieter Ferreira
  https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/poker-table-a48473a5ae7c437496a7aa388f8c458b
  CC Attribution (CC BY 4.0)

Blackjack table
  "Blackjack Table" by ddemon26
  https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/blackjack-table-27a26194c5cf45688d0863289aec0d1d
  CC Attribution (CC BY 4.0)

Playing cards
  "Playing Cards" by jdastine
  https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/playing-cards-2dd7c45bf68a4ce3bf63c995b1bf12bf
  CC Attribution (CC BY 4.0)

Sounds
  Roulette ball: recorded by Maxwell Dufresne, GFXSounds (https://gfxsounds.com), Standard licence
  Cards: "Casino Audio" by Kenney (https://kenney.nl/assets/casino-audio), CC0

HUD fonts
  Chakra Petch and Share Tech Mono, SIL Open Font License (their licences are in fo4roulette\hud)

The plugin's code: GPL-3.0 (fo4roulette-LICENSE.txt).

Slot machine
  Bethesda Game Studios: the Vault-Tec Workshop DLC's slot machine (model, sitting animations, sounds),
  re-skinned as a casino machine. Requires Vault-Tec Workshop (DLCworkshop03.esm).
